title: Willow Creek Holiday Cottage Booking
contextEn: An American visitor phones a UK holiday letting agent to reserve a countryside cottage and check arrival arrangements.

script.text: Good afternoon, Willow Creek Holiday Cottages, Claire speaking. How can I help you?
Hi Claire, I am calling from Boston to book one of your countryside cottages for next month.
Oh, wonderful! I would be happy to arrange that for you. Could I start by taking your name, please?
Sure, it is Daniel Aldridge. Let me spell the last name for you: A-L-D-R-I-D-G-E.
script.ttsText: Sure, it is Daniel Aldridge. Let me spell the last name for you: A, L, D, R, I, D, G, E.

script.text: Thank you, Mr Aldridge. Now, did you have a particular cottage in mind from our website?
I was looking at Fern Cottage, since it is right next to the stream, though we are bringing my sister's small terrier with us.
Ah, Fern Cottage has an open lawn with no gate, so we do not recommend it for dogs. Heather Cottage has a fully enclosed back garden and is free during June.
Oh, that sounds much safer. Let us book Heather Cottage instead then.
Lovely choice, it has a great wood stove too. What date were you planning to arrive?
Um, we leave Boston on 18 June... oh, hang on, it is an overnight flight, so we actually land and arrive at the cottage on 19 June.
script.ttsText: Um, we leave Boston on the eighteenth of June... oh, hang on, it is an overnight flight, so we actually land and arrive at the cottage on the nineteenth of June.

script.text: Good catch! So check-in on 19 June. And how many nights would you like to stay? Most guests take a 4-night short break or a full 7-night week.
script.ttsText: Good catch! So check-in on the nineteenth of June. And how many nights would you like to stay? Most guests take a four-night short break or a full seven-night week.

script.text: We have a wedding in London on the seventh evening, so we need to check out a day early. Could we do 6 nights?
script.ttsText: We have a wedding in London on the seventh evening, so we need to check out a day early. Could we do six nights?

script.text: Certainly, 6 nights is completely fine in June. Could I take a UK mobile number where we can reach you once you arrive?
script.ttsText: Certainly, six nights is completely fine in June. Could I take a UK mobile number where we can reach you once you arrive?

script.text: Yes, I will give you my sister's mobile since she lives in Bristol. It is 07834 912 054... wait, let me double-check my note. Sorry, it ends in 055, so 07834 912 055.
script.ttsText: Yes, I will give you my sister's mobile since she lives in Bristol. It is oh seven eight three four, nine one two, oh five four... wait, let me double-check my note. Sorry, it ends in oh five five, so oh seven eight three four, nine one two, oh five five.

script.text: Got that, ending in oh five five. Now let me calculate the rental fee for you. The base rate for six nights is £680, plus there is a £40 pet cleaning fee, bringing the total rental cost to £720.
script.ttsText: Got that, ending in oh five five. Now let me calculate the rental fee for you. The base rate for six nights is six hundred and eighty pounds, plus there is a forty-pound pet cleaning fee, bringing the total rental cost to seven hundred and twenty pounds.

script.text: Okay, £720 in total. Is there a security deposit on top of that?
script.ttsText: Okay, seven hundred and twenty pounds in total. Is there a security deposit on top of that?

script.text: Only a £150 damage hold on arrival, which is refunded within two days of checkout. How would you like to pay for the booking today?
script.ttsText: Only a hundred and fifty pound damage hold on arrival, which is refunded within two days of checkout. How would you like to pay for the booking today?

script.text: I was thinking of sending a bank transfer, though international transfers can take three business days. Let me just pay by debit card right now so the dates are locked in.
That is much quicker. I will send you a secure debit card payment link by email once we hang up. Before we finish, let me run through a few arrival notes for Heather Cottage.
Yes please, especially about getting the keys if our drive from the airport runs late.

You do not need to worry about arriving late because we use a coded key safe. Last summer it was mounted beside the front porch, though we recently moved it next to the wooden shed at the side of the driveway.
Right, next to the shed, not the porch. And what is the earliest time we can get into the cottage?
Normally check-in is at 4:00 p.m., um, let me check the cleaning roster for Friday the nineteenth... oh, actually the housekeepers finish early that afternoon, so you can check in from 3:30 p.m.
script.ttsText: Normally check-in is at four o'clock in the afternoon, um, let me check the cleaning roster for Friday the nineteenth... oh, actually the housekeepers finish early that afternoon, so you can check in from three thirty p.m.

script.text: Oh, 3:30 is fantastic after a long flight. Are there shops nearby where we can pick up groceries?
script.ttsText: Oh, three thirty is fantastic after a long flight. Are there shops nearby where we can pick up groceries?

script.text: Yes, there is a small bakery in the village that shuts on Monday, and a wonderful local farm shop half a mile down the lane. Just keep in mind the farm shop is closed every Wednesday.
Okay, farm shop closed on Wednesday. I will note that down so we stock up beforehand.
Perfect. I will email your booking summary and the key code twenty-four hours before you arrive. Have a smooth flight over, Daniel!
Thanks a lot, Claire. Really looking forward to it!

traps.explanationVi: Người gọi đánh vần từng chữ cái họ A-L-D-R-I-D-G-E.
Ban đầu xem Fern Cottage nhưng đổi sang Heather vì có sân vườn rào kín cho chó.

questions.prompt: Date of arrival at the cottage

traps.explanationVi: 18 June là ngày bay từ Boston, tự sửa lại ngày đến nhà nghỉ là 19 June.
Nhân viên nhắc gói 4 hoặc 7 đêm, nhưng khách phải về sớm nên chỉ đặt 6 đêm.
Đọc nhầm đuôi 054 rồi kiểm tra ghi chú và sửa thành 055.

questions.prompt: Total rental cost including pet fee (in pounds)

traps.explanationVi: 680 bảng mới là giá gốc, cộng 40 bảng phí thú cưng thành tổng 720 bảng.
Bỏ ý định chuyển khoản vì mất ba ngày, chọn thanh toán ngay bằng debit card.
